getShading

public int getShading()
Returns the shading. if shading is 0, the cadrat is not shaded; else, the shading is given by the sum of the constants TOP_LEFT... which state which quarter of the cadrat is shaded. Note that we provide an easier interface.

int

isWide

public boolean isWide()
A cadrat is wide if it contain a box filled with a wide sign.

A wide sign is a sign that can be streched horizontally (in practice, \l marks such signs).

Returns:
true if the cadrat is wide.
